title: Bound exact bit work at fixed elimination depth
statement: A fixed number of maximal stages controls coefficient heights;the unrestricted arithmetic-count claim is weaker.

evidence.quote: # Independent audit: hidden Gaussian quartic compiler
# Second independent audit: fixed-depth compilation and rounded sampling

requires: Exact DENSE RATIONAL coefficients of degree<=4 potential V:R^n->R;no Gaussian-generating map,SOS decomposition,hidden coordinates or flag supplied. Gaussian-direction lemma assumes GLOBAL boundedness below;integrability makes discovered block curvature PD. Recognizer need not assume positivity:it explicitly verifies polynomial square-completion identities,nonsingular coordinate maps,PD curvatures and terminal scalar. Completeness ONLY for unknown V=c+||q0+Lx+L b(x,x)||^2,L invertible,b symmetric bilinear with full lowering flag b(F_j,R^n)subsetF_(j-1). Fixed depth d counts nonempty MAXIMAL Gaussian blocks.
provides: Use fraction-free elimination/determinant ratios and direct bounded-degree substitutions,not an arbitrary long rational circuit. H_next+1<=C(n+1)^c(H+log(n+1)+1),henceH_max<=[C(n+1)^c]^d(H_input+log(n+1)+1).

Positive rational determinants/pivots and covariance inverse magnitudes have logarithms polynomial in certificate height;no free real-conditioning oracle. This exact-input bit bound is not robustness to noisy inputs.
assumptions: Not generic quartic integration/nonconvex optimization,all polynomial Gaussianizations,causal graph identification or noisy-observation learning. General-depth intermediate coefficient-height bound OPEN;unbounded-depth ordinary positional outputs can require exponential bits with constant probability. Finite-bit output cannot approximate continuous law inTV;only explicitly rounded target is promised. Exact kernel/recognition discontinuous even forTV-close laws;no approximate recovery or noisy coefficient acquisition theorem. Exact rational height pays small pivots/conditioning,not practical machine precision. Essential-variable reduction,causal layer/Hessian methods,supplied Rosenbrock/NICE transports are established strongest comparators;no priority/practical advantage established. Original draft concerns are superseded ONLY for the later explicit lowering-flag/fixed-depth/rounded statements accepted by final audits.
costs: Dense quartics have O(n^4)coefficients. At mostn maximal stages,polynomial RATIONAL FIELD-operation count;store unexpanded compositional transport. General Turing work polynomial in n and ENCOUNTERED rational heightH,not known polynomial in original input. Fraction-free/minor bases give H_next+1<=poly(n)(H+log(n+1)+1);fixed d yields n^O(d)height/Turing work,degree may depend ond. Rounded sampler target Round_Delta(X),Delta=2^-p,integerp>=0;TV<=epsilon,work polynomial(n,p,H,log(1/epsilon),2^d). Complexity polynomial inp,not logp. Symbolic Z=e^-c product |detT|pi^(blockdim/2)/sqrt(detQ);logZ approximation separate from explicitly writing tinyZ.
